title: Kolibri Learning Platform
description: Open-source educational platform designed for off-grid schools. Syncs curriculum content, books, and exercises over local micro-Wi-Fi without consuming cellular data.

title: KICD Kenya National Curriculum Broadcasts
description: Official competency-based curriculum lessons broadcast via free-to-air radio and scheduled television channels, bypasses smartphone and airtime requirements.

title: Rwanda Basic Education Board (REB) E-Learning
description: Official digital textbook repository. Zero-rated on designated local mobile networks, allowing syllabus downloads without deducting airtime balance.

title: African Storybook Project
description: Open-access illustrated storybooks published in over 200 African languages (including Kiswahili, Kinyarwanda, and Bemba), downloadable as lightweight printable PDFs.

title: Zambia MoE Open Educational Resources
description: National primary and secondary syllabus units and curriculum teacher guides, formatted for low-bandwidth mobile viewing and print distribution.

title: Siyavula Open STEM Practice
description: Curriculum-aligned mathematics and physical sciences adaptive practice modules, optimized for low-bandwidth mobile browsers with open CC-BY licenses.
